meta.name: io-figma
meta.description: Guides work on the Figma I/O package (@grida/io-figma, packages/grida-canvas-io-figma/). Covers the fig-kiwi binary parser, Kiwi→REST→Grida conversion pipeline, fig2grida CLI, REST API JSON conversion, and testing with clipboard/fig/REST fixtures. Use when adding node type support, fixing conversion bugs, extending fig2grida, working on the fig-kiwi parser, writing tests for Figma import, or debugging clipboard paste failures after a Figma update.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能解析 Figma 文件（.fig 或 REST API JSON）并转换为 Grida 格式。它可以处理二进制解析、转换管道、CLI 工具和测试。
howto.when: 当你需要添加 Figma 节点类型支持、修复转换错误、扩展 fig2grida 工具、处理 fig-kiwi 解析器、编写 Figma 导入测试，或调试 Figma 更新后的剪贴板粘贴失败时触发。
